title: Best Dehumidifiers UK
short: Compressor and desiccant dehumidifiers compared by extraction rate, tank size, noise and the rooms they suit.
intro: Damp, condensation and slow-drying laundry are a fact of UK autumns and winters, and a dehumidifier is one of the most effective fixes. This guide compares models tested in real homes by Mumsnet and Expert Reviews so you can match the type and capacity to your rooms.

products.name: MeacoDry Arete One
products.best_for: Bedrooms to whole homes, depending on the model size
products.summary: Mumsnet has tested 20 dehumidifiers in real homes and this remains its best overall. Its tester found it efficient, quiet and easy to wheel between rooms, and it doubles as an air purifier with a laundry mode and a five-year warranty. 10, 20 and 25L versions also exist.
pros: Dehumidifier and air purifier in one

products.name: Arete Two 20L
products.best_for: Whole-house damp and laundry in larger homes
products.summary: Expert Reviews' best dehumidifier overall: quiet for its power, efficient at drying laundry and energy efficient, though it found some app functions unintuitive. Mumsnet separately tested the smaller 12L version (2.5L tank, 35dB, QuietMark certified) and names it its best smart dehumidifier, praising the app and smart home control but calling it expensive.
cons: Scheduling features are hard to find

products.name: PB-08 20L
products.best_for: Drying laundry in larger homes on a tighter budget
products.summary: A cheaper alternative to the Arete Two with a larger tank and an excellent laundry mode, at the cost of higher power use and more noise.

products.name: ActivAir SH16810N
products.best_for: Anyone who wants a set-and-forget dehumidifier
products.summary: A minimalist, affordable compressor model with simple set-and-forget controls, at the cost of a small tank and limited features.

products.name: 368120 Smart Dehumidifier
products.best_for: Buyers who want app control and scheduling
products.summary: A compressor model with smartphone control and scheduling that copes with larger spaces, though it removes moisture more slowly than the best rivals.

products.name: AriaDry Multi
products.best_for: Small to mid-sized rooms and laundry drying
products.summary: A stylish compressor unit that removes moisture effectively and has an easy-to-empty tank, though it is noisy and the small tank needs frequent emptying.

products.name: 12L Dehumidifier
products.summary: Expert Reviews calls it the least obtrusive and quietest option it tested. It is portable and easy to use, but the small tank means frequent emptying.

products.name: DD8L Zambezi
products.best_for: Cold spaces such as garages and conservatories where compressors struggle
products.summary: A low-noise desiccant model that keeps working in cold temperatures and has an excellent laundry mode, though its peak power draw is high.

products.name: Slimline 10L Dehumidifier
products.best_for: Small rooms and faster laundry drying on a budget
products.summary: Mumsnet's best budget pick. Its tester found the laundry mode halved the drying time of a 6kg load, from 16 hours to eight, and the castors made it easy to move, but the small tank needed emptying mid-load and it was audible even in sleep mode.
pros: Laundry mode speeds up indoor drying
cons: Occasional drips from the drainage opening
Noticeable noise, even in sleep mode

products.name: DD8L Pro Desiccant Dehumidifier
products.best_for: Drying laundry in cold houses and unheated spaces
products.summary: Mumsnet's pick for drying laundry. Paired with a pedestal fan it cut drying time by hours in testing, and it adds night mode, a smart energy mode and app control. As a desiccant model it costs more to run than a compressor and is fairly noisy on full power.
pros: Easy to move around the house
cons: Not as economical to run as a compressor model

products.name: MRD25GW 25L
products.best_for: Large, damp homes that need maximum extraction
products.summary: Mumsnet's best 25L dehumidifier: a high-capacity model it describes as fast and efficient, with a large tank, wheels and an intuitive app, though there is no night mode or remote control.

products.name: Piccola Desiccant Dehumidifier
products.best_for: Small rooms, cold spaces and wall-mounting
products.summary: A compact, quiet desiccant unit that works at low temperatures and can be wall-mounted, though it is expensive for its size and has no laundry mode.

guide.a: Compressor models are generally cheaper to run in heated rooms. Desiccant models keep working in cold spaces, such as garages, conservatories and unheated rooms, where compressors become less effective, but they tend to use more power.

guide.q: What size dehumidifier do I need?
guide.a: Extraction rate (litres per day) is a rough capacity guide. Models in the 10-12L range suit a bedroom or small flat, while 20L models suit whole-house damp and drying large loads of laundry.

guide.q: What humidity level should I aim for?
guide.a: Many manufacturers suggest keeping indoor humidity roughly between 40% and 60%. A cheap hygrometer helps you see whether the dehumidifier is working.

guide.q: Will a dehumidifier get rid of mould?
guide.a: It reduces the damp that mould needs to grow, but it will not remove mould that is already there. Clean existing mould and fix leaks or ventilation problems at the source.
